summary.text: Michael Sugar is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 40, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he won the May 19 Democratic primary with 71.3 percent of the vote over Charles Gallia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a high school history teacher and union member.

paragraphs.text: Sugar is running for an open seat; Ballotpedia lists no incumbent in the race, and his general-election opponents are Republican Adam Baker and Pat Hubbell of the Independent Party of Oregon.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his campaign centers on lowering the cost of living, making health care more affordable and accessible, and improving and investing in public schools.
He also said he is passionate about affordable housing, public education, public safety and responsible environmental stewardship.
